route.loopAt: Loop service, starting and ending at {stop} (loops at {loop})
route.tap_the_stop_youre_getting: Tap the stop you're getting off at. Keep the site open on the bus, and it alerts you two stops before.
routine.description: A stop’s next buses as a notification at a time you set, on the days you pick: your stop at 7:45 on weekdays, say.
routine.explain.notification: At that time, on those days, a notification shows the stop’s next buses. Tap it for their timings.
routine.new.buses: All of them, or some: 22, 222, or 22* for every 22
routine.new.stop_required: Open a stop or save a favourite first
routine.updateForWild: Update the app to 2.2.3 for a routine with 22* and the like, or list the buses.
scan.noCamera: The camera isn’t allowed. Allow Camera for SG Bus Timings in Android’s settings, then try again.
scan.point: Point the camera at the 5-digit code on the bus stop’s pole
search.badCode: Please enter a valid 5-digit bus stop code.
search.nearPostal: Bus stops near this postal code
search.noMatch: No bus stops matched that. Try a bus stop number or part of its name.
search.noPostal: No address has the postal code {code}.
search.postalFailed: Couldn't look up that postal code. Please try again.
search.typeSomething: Type a bus stop name, 5-digit stop code, 6-digit postal code, or bus number.
settings.bus_times_note: How long till each bus comes, such as 3 mins 20s, or the time it comes, such as 14:32. Every bus timing in the app follows it.
settings.confetti_each_time_you_open: Confetti each time you open the app on your birthday.
settings.custom_home_edge_tray_side: Custom home · Edge Tray side · Edge Tray buttons · Favourites first or last
settings.each_page_shows_you_around: Each page shows you around the first time you open it. Pick one to see its tour again.
settings.earphones_only_with_earphones_i: Earphones only: with earphones in, the beeps play just in them; without, the phone only buzzes. Never out loud on a quiet bus.
settings.favourites_places_routines_your: Favourites, places, routines, your calendar, settings and more. Show a code on one device and enter it on the other. Both need to be on the same wifi, or one joined to the other’s hotspot. Closing Settings ends the sync.
settings.findNone: No setting by that name. Try a word such as tray, alert or sync.
settings.for_events_in_this_phones: For events in this phone's calendar with a place: a notification when it's time to set off by bus and train, from where you are, or from Home.
settings.for_people_who_work_there: For people who work there: with a pass, Navigate can get on and off inside Changi Airport's cargo area and at MINDEF's stops, which it otherwise keeps away from.
settings.get_off_alert_on_a: Get Off Alert on a trip
settings.give_the_phone_a_firm: Give the phone a firm shake to refresh the timings on screen.
settings.journeys_across_the_causeway_co: Journeys across the Causeway count this for getting off, clearing both checkpoints and getting on again. By the time: about 15 min when it's quiet, up to an hour at the rush (weekday mornings into Singapore, evenings and Friday nights out to JB, Sunday nights back).
settings.language_note2: The app opens again in the language picked.
settings.last_bus_reminders.description: Tap the bell by a bus's last bus time at a stop: a reminder 20 minutes before it, every day it runs.
settings.name_birthday_confetti_places_c: Language · Name · Birthday · Confetti · Places · Calendar
settings.on_a_trip_or_with: On a trip or with the live map open, leaving the app shrinks it into a small window over your other apps. Off, it goes to the background like any other app, and the Get Off Alert still comes as a notification.
settings.on_your_birthday_the_greeting: On your birthday, the greeting wishes you a happy one, with your age if the year's set.
settings.or_enter_the_other_devices: Or enter the other device’s code
settings.restricted_areas_immigration_ti: Restricted areas · Immigration time · Cycling · Shuttle buses
settings.short.name: Name
settings.show_a_code_on_this: Show a code on this device
settings.show_me_around_sgbus_terminal_c: Show me around · sgbus terminal · uwuCoins
settings.shuttles_note: Shuttle buses, such as NUS's and NTU's, IKEA's and Changi Airport's, in Navigate and on Explorer's map. Paid ones, such as Mandai's and the TS1 to Johor Bahru, only with Free and paid. A hotel's shuttle is only used to or from that hotel.
settings.something_not_working_tell_augy: Something not working? Tell Augy what happened, and it reaches him on Telegram.
settings.sync_code_tap_to_copy: Sync code. Tap to copy the link
settings.sync_with_another_device_or: Sync with another device or Telegram
settings.the_edge_tray_is_the: The Edge Tray is the column of buttons at the top of the screen. Its arrow tucks it away at the edge.
settings.the_linux_apps_commands_typed: The Linux app's commands, typed at an sgbus> prompt: 84009, nav home work, favs. On a computer, Ctrl+` opens it too.
settings.the_page_the_app_opens: The page the app opens on, first in the Edge Tray. Each of these is a page of its own: tap its button at the top of the tray to switch to it. A link to a stop, a bus or a journey still opens that. Pages turned off in Edge Tray buttons, below, aren’t here.
settings.turn_off_the_buttons_you: Turn off the buttons you don’t use, for a tidier tray. Glance, Service alerts and Your trips are pages: off, each leaves the tray and Custom home too, and if it was home, the app opens on Bus timings. The trips you take are still kept with Your trips off. The guide is also at guide.sgbus.uwuapps.org.
settings.two_stops_before_you_get: Two stops before you get off or change, the phone buzzes "OFF" in Morse code, beeps and shows a notification. Keep the site open on a trip.
settings.when_you_seem_to_be: When you seem to be riding with no trip running, a quiet notification offers to start one, for the Get Off Alert. Needs Physical activity.
settings.with_a_bike_navigate_also: With a bike, Navigate also says how long cycling there takes, and a trip tells you when cycling the rest of the way is quicker.
settings.with_another_device_or_the: With another device or the Telegram bot
settings.with_the_bot_what_you: With the bot, what you sync passes through this site’s server, kept for 10 minutes at most. Between two devices, it goes straight from one to the other.
settings.your_events_with_a_location: Your events with a location show under Calendar in Navigate's From, To and Add a stop.

team.about: Speedrun the feats with friends. Rides and trips any of you take count for the whole team, and everyone gets each feat the team does, with its 100 uwuCoins. Hand a trip on by starting yours where a teammate’s ended, within 30 minutes.
team.badCode: A team code is ten letters and numbers, such as abcde12345.
team.code: Or join one with its code
team.copied: Invite copied. Send it to your team.
team.handoff: {name}’s trip ended {m} min ago. Carry it on from where they got to within {left} min, and it counts as the one trip.
team.handoffYours: Your trip ended {m} min ago. A teammate can carry it on from where you got to, for {left} min more.
team.inAnother: You’re in {team} already. Leave it to join another.
team.inviteText: Join my team run, {team}, in SG Bus Timings, to speedrun the feats together. Team code: {code}
team.joinAsk: Put in your name and tap Join to join this team run.
team.leaveConfirm: Leave {team}? The feats you’ve had from it stay yours.
team.name: Start a team run
team.namePlaceholder: Team name, such as Night Owls
team.needName: Give the team a name first.
team.needYou: Put in your name first, for your team to see.
team.rules: Only rides your phone’s location shows you took count, as in your own Achievements. A team run ends 14 days after its last ride.
team.summary: The team: {n} of {all} feats done, {rides} rides between you
team.title: Team run
theme.brandAway: Your colours are on. The brand colours come back with Back to the usual colours.
gta6.title: GTA VI’s colours
gta6.text: To celebrate the game’s release on 19 November, there’s a new theme in its logo’s pink, blue, orange, yellow and violet.
gta6.keep: Set it before 26 November and it’s yours to keep, even if you change colours later. After that, you’ll have to win it on the uwuCoins wheel.
gta6.replace: This replaces Your colours. You can pick them again any time.
gta6.setNote: Set GTA VI before 26 November to keep it for good.
gta6.locked: Win GTA VI on the uwuCoins wheel.
coins.gta6Due: The egg slice wins GTA VI’s colours first.
coins.wonGta6More: They’re yours to keep. Pick them in Theme.
theme.contrast.note: Darker text, solid cards and clear edges, for reading in bright light or with low vision.
theme.title: Theme
timings.scan_the_code_on_a: Scan the code on a bus stop's pole
timings.search_by_name_or_code: Search by name or code (e.g. Bedok Interchange or 84009)
timings.the_bus_stops_around_you: The bus stops around you, nearest first.
timings.tip_search_by_stop_name: Tip: search by stop name (e.g. “Orchard”), 5-digit stop code, 6-digit postal code for the stops near an address, or a bus number (e.g. “22”) to see its route.
tour.alerts.1: Be told about MRT and LRT disruptions and road incidents, even with the app closed: every update, disruptions only, or off.
tour.alerts.2: What’s going on right now, on the trains and the roads.
tour.explorer.1: Stops are white dots ringed in green, stations dots in their line’s colour, interchanges pills in all of theirs. Zoom in for the stops.
tour.explorer.2: Tap a dot for its card: a stop’s buses, green while running, red down to their last three, grey when not; a station’s doors to stand at on each platform. Every card has Directions.
tour.explorer.3: The compass turns the map with you, the way your phone points up.
tour.explorer.4: Layers picks what the map shows: bus stops, MRT and LRT stations and lines, and shuttle buses’ routes and stops. Tap one to turn it off or on.
tour.explorer.5: Back closes Explorer. Its button in the Edge Tray can be turned off in Settings.
tour.favs.1: Every stop you’ve starred. Tap one for its timings.
tour.favs.2: Buses you’ve starred. Glance shows only these at your stops.
tour.favs.3: Journeys you’ve saved in Navigate, ready to plan again in a tap.
tour.favs.4: Nothing here yet. Tap the star on a stop, a bus or a journey in Navigate, and it shows here.
tour.glance.1: Your next bus, big enough to read on the move. Tap it for all its times.
tour.glance.2: Pick whose buses: your saved stops, the ones nearby, or the ones near Home or Work.
tour.glance.3: Each bus on one line, with its next three times. Tap one for the full timings, and the star there saves the stop. Star a bus, and only your buses show here.
tour.glance.4: Each page has its button at the top of the Edge Tray: {pages}. Press and hold a button to see what it does.
tour.glance.5: In Settings, Pages and Edge Tray has Custom home, the page the app opens on, and Help and extras has Show me around, for any page’s tour again.
tour.nav.1: Bus and train plans with the MRT too; Bus only keeps to buses, stop to stop.
tour.nav.2: Where from and where to: a place, an address, a stop, a postal code. Home, Work and your places are a tap away under each box.
tour.nav.3: Leave now, leave at a time, or arrive by one.
tour.nav.4: Your ways, quickest first. Open one for every part of it, which train door to stand at, and Start trip to be told when to get off.
tour.nav.5: Save the journey to Favourites, and Share sends it to someone.
tour.places.1: Home, Work and your own places. Tap one for the way there from where you are.
tour.places.2: The dots edit, share or delete it.
tour.places.3: Add a place: the gym, school, a friend’s. Each one shows under From and To in Navigate, and on Glance.
tour.terminal.1: Type a command, as on the Linux command line: a stop like 84009, a stop’s name, nav home work, favs. Tab finishes a word, and Up brings back the last one.
tour.terminal.2: The answers show here. Ctrl+C stops one that keeps updating, or clears the line; with text selected, it copies.
tour.terminal.3: Esc, exit or this closes it. Ctrl+` opens it again on a computer, as does Settings.
tour.timings.1: Look up any stop by its name or 5-digit code, the stops near an address by its postal code, or a bus by its number for its route.
tour.timings.2: Or say it: a stop, a road or a bus number.
tour.timings.3: Or scan the code on a bus stop’s pole with the camera.
tour.timings.4: The stops around you, nearest first. Tap one for its timings.
tour.timings.5: Today’s weather and air, before you head out.
tour.trips.1: Each trip you take with Start trip shows here. Start one from a way in Navigate, or a bus’s route.
tour.trips.2: How many trips and rides you’ve taken, and how long on the move.
tour.trips.3: How your time splits between walking, waiting and riding, and the buses and lines you ride most.
tour.trips.4: Each trip, by week. Tap one for its rides and times, to take it again or share it.
